draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Mananthavady! This little town feels like a maze, but walk it early in the morning and you'll see it's laid out like a giant number 8. The big loop circles the Latin Church Hill, the small one circles the Government Offices Hill, and a Gandhi statue stands where they meet.
draft.hungryLine: Look out for Wayanad's bamboo rice, local tea and coffee, and a good plate of palappam with mutton curry.

moodReplies.show-me-around: Start at the Pazhassi Museum and Garden near the bus station, climb to the Latin Church, then head 3 km out to Valliyoorkkavu Temple.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Pack a picnic for V.C. Road near Valliyoorkkavu, where the whole area looks like a green lawn by the river.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Mananthavady Park by the river is known for its bat colony, and attempts to get rid of the bats sparked protests.

legends.title: Once-in-a-lifetime rice
legends.body: Bamboo is said to yield seeds only after a very long time. So harvesting bamboo rice, or mulayari, is said to be a once-in-a-lifetime thing.

legends.title: The place called 42
legends.body: Locals call Boys Town just '42'. It's the distance in miles from there to Kannur.

tips.title: Walk the town early.
tips.body: Evening traffic packs the sidewalks, but an early morning walk shows you the figure-eight layout.

tips.title: Call before Kuruva Dweep.
tips.body: The islands sometimes close when water levels run high in the rains, and you shouldn't stay on them after dusk.

story.title: The Mother Goddess
story.body: Valliyoorkkavu Temple honours the Mother Goddess as Vana Durga, Bhadrakali and Jala Durga. In darker times, slaves were traded during its festival.

story.title: The Lion of Kerala
story.body: Veera Pazhassi Raja led a guerrilla war against the British East India Company. His museum and garden sit near the bus station.

story.title: A sanctuary is born
story.body: The Wayanad (Muthanga) Wildlife Sanctuary was established, part of the Nilgiri Biosphere Reserve, India's first UNESCO biosphere reserve.

story.title: The tribal gathering
story.body: Valliyoorkkavu's 15-day festival in March or April is the grandest in the district, and still the largest gathering of Wayanad's tribal communities.

story.title: Trace the 8
story.body: Walk both loops of town before breakfast, then ride the 6:10 AM bus to Kutta through the forest. Tell me what you saw from the window.
